svg.title: Activity rhythm
svg.desc: Boolean public contribution observations, grouped by UTC week and kind. Cell fill encodes the observed active-day count from zero to seven. Each cell title gives the observed denominator and missing days. Hatching means no observations; a slash means some observations are missing. Types overlap and are never added into a contribution total. Of 364 calendar days, 305 are observed for every activity type and 59 have at least one unknown type. Declared coverage gaps span 61 days: 1 Apr 2026 to 31 May 2026 (GitHub contribution connection cap). Inside a gap a missing observation is unknown, never zero; an observed active day remains a lower bound.

text.font-family: 'FiraCode Nerd Font Mono', 'SFMono-Regular', Menlo, Consolas, monospace
'Inter', Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif
